Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers (LET) Reviewer

SPED Laws, Policies, and Ethical Standards
1. The primary law in the Philippines that institutionalized inclusive education for learners with
disabilities is:
A. R.A. 9155
B. R.A. 7277
C. R.A. 10533
D. R.A. 9442
2. R.A. 7277 is known as the:
A. Magna Carta for Disabled Persons
B. Education Act of 1982
C. Enhanced Basic Education Act
D. Inclusive Education Bill
3. The implementing rules of R.A. 7277 ensure that learners with disabilities:
A. Are educated separately at all times
B. Have access to quality education and services
C. Are limited to SPED centers only
D. Are excluded from public schools
4. The SPED teacher’s code of ethics emphasizes:
A. Strict competition among learners
B. Respect for individual differences and human dignity
C. Equal treatment through uniform expectations
D. Academic ranking
5. Under DepEd Order No. 72, s. 2009, inclusive education means:
A. Placing all learners in regular classes without support
B. Educating all learners together with appropriate assistance
C. Segregating learners by ability
D. Assigning separate curricula
6. The law that strengthens the implementation of special education programs and services in the
Philippines is:
A. R.A. 7277
B. DepEd Order No. 26, s. 1997
C. R.A. 10533
D. DepEd Order No. 72, s. 2009
7. The “child find” system aims to:
A. Locate, identify, and evaluate children with disabilities
B. Categorize learners by grade level
C. Exclude learners from assessment
D. Recruit teachers for SPED centers
8. The IEP (Individualized Education Program) is a legal document that:
A. Lists the student’s learning goals, supports, and services
B. Provides uniform grading standards
C. Is used only for gifted learners
D. Replaces parent involvement
9. Parental participation in SPED programs is mandated by:
A. Teacher’s Manual
B. IEP Process
C. School Principal
D. Student Handbook
10. The international agreement that promotes the rights of persons with disabilities is:
A. Salamanca Statement (1994)
B. Geneva Convention

C. Paris Accord
D. UNESCO Literacy Charter
11. The philosophy of inclusion is most consistent with which principle?
A. Every learner has the right to learn and belong
B. Education is only for the capable
C. Learners with disabilities should be separated
D. Only special schools can serve SPED learners
12. The least restrictive environment (LRE) principle ensures that:
A. Learners are placed in settings appropriate to their needs
B. All learners are placed in SPED centers
C. Only mild disabilities are accommodated
D. Schools decide placement without assessment
13. A SPED teacher must maintain confidentiality because:
A. It is part of professional ethics and respect for learner rights
B. Parents should not be informed
C. Data privacy is optional
D. It avoids teacher accountability
14. Under the Code of Ethics for Professional Teachers, a teacher shall not:
A. Discriminate against any learner
B. Offer equal opportunities
C. Uphold fairness
D. Support inclusion
15. Which agency oversees the implementation of SPED programs in public schools?
A. DepEd
B. CHED
C. TESDA
D. DSWD
16. The Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2013 (R.A. 10533) emphasizes:
A. K-12 curriculum with inclusive and learner-centered approaches
B. Focus on traditional academic skills
C. Removal of inclusive programs
D. Elimination of SPED centers
17. In inclusive education, assessment should be:
A. Continuous and individualized
B. Standardized and identical
C. Limited to paper-and-pencil tests
D. Administered once a year
18. A SPED teacher reports a suspected case of child abuse. This demonstrates:
A. Professional responsibility and child protection compliance
B. Breach of confidentiality
C. Overstepping authority
D. Avoidance of school process
19. A parent disagrees with a learner’s placement in the IEP. The teacher should:
A. Facilitate a review meeting with the IEP team
B. Ignore the concern
C. Proceed without consent
D. Transfer the child to another school
20. The law prohibiting discrimination against persons with disability in employment and education
is:
A. R.A. 7277
B. R.A. 9442
C. R.A. 10533
D. R.A. 9155
21. The Salamanca Statement advocates:
A. Inclusive education as a fundamental right
B. Separation of learners with disabilities
C. Academic segregation
D. Teacher-centered instruction

22. One major ethical responsibility of SPED teachers is to:
A. Advocate for learners’ rights and inclusion
B. Prioritize grading
C. Ignore family involvement
D. Focus on test scores
23. The term “inclusive education” in the Philippine context means:
A. Education for all, regardless of ability, gender, or background
B. Segregated education for special learners
C. Specialized schools only
D. Home-based learning for all
24. The SPED teacher’s professional accountability includes:
A. Adhering to ethical standards and confidentiality
B. Sharing student data publicly
C. Allowing bias in evaluation
D. Favoring specific learners
25. The right of learners with disabilities to free and appropriate public education is ensured by:
A. R.A. 7277 and the Salamanca Statement
B. The Philippine Constitution alone
C. Local ordinances
D. School policy
